{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness long-term memory & self-evolving plugin: L0 capture -> L1 memory extraction -> L2 scene grouping -> L3 user persona, auto recall injection + skill synthesis, fully local.","id":"gh:1335269450","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-self-improved","slug":"madage/dsh-self-improved","topics":["agent-memory","ai-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","fts5","long-term-memory","memory","privacy","self-improvement","skill-synthesis","sqlite"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness long-term memory & self-evolving plugin: L0 capture -> L1 memory extraction -> L2 s"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"cene grouping -> L3 user persona, auto recall injection + skill synthesis, fully local."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-self-improved"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin** for DeepSeek Harness (fully local)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Status: M0–M6 complete and deployed to a real environment (web profile). Design/research docs stay"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" local only (see `.gitignore`)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Adds the two missing capabilities to DSH — "cross-session memory + self-evolution":"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Memory**: automatically distills key points from conversations (facts / preferences / events / i"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"nstructions) into a local memory store; before each new turn, relevant memories are injected to the "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"model — the AI "remembers you".
- **Self-evolution**: memories are consolidated, decayed and correct"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ed; successful workflows can be distilled into reusable skills; the user persona keeps evolving with"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"workflows can be distilled into reusable skills; the user persona keeps evolving with conversations."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The architecture follows the four-layer memory pyramid of TencentDB Agent Memory (L0 capture → L1 ex"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"traction → L2 scene grouping → L3 persona), but **reuses DSH-native services** (`ctx.llm` / `session"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"` events / `agent/pre-step` injection / `dsh-skill` / `storageDomain`) with a fully local SQLite sto"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"re (FTS5 + sqlite-vec). No data is uploaded anywhere."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Milestone | Scope | Status |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| M0 | Probe: event capture / recall injection / tool registration / settings namespace | ✅ Verified"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" (isolated headless) |
| M1 | Memory store: SQLite + FTS5 + jieba + sqlite-vec; L0 capture to disk; "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"memory/search tools | ✅ Verified (unit + headless integration) |
| M2 | Extraction pipeline: `ctx.ll"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"m` L1 extraction + strict JSON validation/fallback + dedup + throttled pump | ✅ Unit-tested; running"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" in production |
| M3 | Recall injection: `agent/pre-step` injection + keyword/vector/hybrid retriev"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"al (RRF) | ✅ Unit-tested + end-to-end verified |
| M4 | Self-evolution: L2/L3 consolidation (scenes "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"+ versioned persona), decay, correct/forget tools, skill synthesis → dsh-skill | ✅ Unit-tested; synt"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"hesized skills in production |
| M5 | UI/ops: settings panel (auto-rendered) + hot runtime toggles +"},{"id":"p11s9","text":" `/memory` command + memory browser | ✅ Complete, deployed to web profile |
| M6 | Growth governance"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" (caps/cleanup) + scheduling (nightly review / free maintenance / startup backfill) | ✅ Complete: go"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"vernance caps, nightly review (default 22:00), 15-min loop is maintenance-only, master switch stops "},{"id":"p11s12","text":"s, nightly review (default 22:00), 15-min loop is maintenance-only, master switch stops all timers |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> **Since 0.1.1**: the package declares `dsh.bundle`, so **`dsh plugin add` / plugin-marketplace one"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"-click install auto-mounts it** (dsh registers it as a profile layer automatically) — **no manual `c"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ordis.patch.yml` edits needed**. Just restart dsh after installing."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Option 1: npm (recommended; same as marketplace one-click)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Option 2: from GitHub (source snapshot, prepare builds lib/ automatically)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> Manual mount (legacy versions or special layouts only): add to the `insert` list of `$DSH_HOME/pro"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"files/web/cordis.patch.yml`:
>
[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Option 3: local development (file: link)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### ⚠️ Install notice: peerDependencies double-instance pitfall (located & fixed)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Symptom**: after install, **new sessions work but resuming an old session errors** — `deployment:p"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ersona already registered`, with a hint "register through that agent's agent.ctx instead"."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Root cause (not a plugin bug)**: pnpm's default `autoInstallPeers` installs the plugin's `@deepsee"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"k-ai/*` peerDependencies as **physical copies** inside the profile's `node_modules`, creating two in"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"dependent module instances of the same package as the ones embedded in the dsh main install (e.g. `d"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"sh-scope`). DSH's scoping (preset/persona layers) binds identity via `Symbol("dsh.scope")`; with two"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" instances the persona registration lands in the global layer and collides with the host's `deployme"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"nt:persona` → resume fails. New sessions happen to succeed because the global layer is not yet occup"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ied on first registration."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Fix (verified)**:
1. Replace the redundant `@deepseek-ai/*` physical copies in the profile with **"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"symlinks** to the packages embedded in the dsh main install (dsh's self-healing layout `$DSH_HOME/pr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ofiles/node_modules`);
2. Set `auto-install-peers=false` in a profile-level `.npmrc` (or turn off `a"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"utoInstallPeers` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Note for users (keep when publishing)**:
> dsh-self-improved's peerDependencies may be auto-instal"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"led as physical copies in the profile; use the dsh self-healing symlink layout, or set `auto-install"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"-peers=false` in the profile's `.npmrc`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### ⚠️ Install notice: duplicate loader entry id (bundle re-mount, instant boot crash)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Symptom**: dsh **fails to start** (window flashes and closes), and `dsh --profile web --dump-confi"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"g` shows the same entry `id` twice."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"**Root cause**: packages declaring `dsh.bundle` (this plugin since 0.1.1, `dsh-plugin-marketplace`, "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"etc.) are **automatically** added to `dsh.profile.bundles` and their bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inse"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"rts one entry; if the profile-level `cordis.patch.yml` **also manually inserts the same id** → the l"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"oader throws `duplicate loader entry id` at boot."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Fix (verified)**: reset the profile-level `cordis.patch.yml` to `[]` — bundle assembly is fully ow"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ned by `dsh.profile.bundles`; do **not** manually insert bundle plugins at the profile layer."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**Debug tip**: if dsh crashes at startup, run `dsh --profile web --dump-config` and count each entry"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" id; more than one occurrence is this problem."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Notes:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **Master switch off = plugin fully dormant**: all background timers stop (15-min maintenance loop "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"/ nightly review / startup backfill), `/memory` and memory tools are unregistered; stored memories a"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"re kept and everything resumes when re-enabled.
